name: Burlington County, NJ
findings: Burlington County has 1,648 nonprofit organizations. 777 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 630 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Burlington County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 34 research and think tank organizations here list membership, compared with about 13 in similar places of this size.
